# BibMe

> BibMe is a comprehensive academic writing platform offering citation generation, plagiarism detection, and grammar checking tools for students and researchers.

BibMe provides automated citation formatting across multiple styles (APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE, AMA, ASA, CSE), plagiarism detection, and grammar checking features. The platform supports academic writing across various citation formats and helps students avoid accidental plagiarism while improving essay quality.

## Key Topics

- Citation generation
- Plagiarism checker
- Grammar checker
- APA format
- MLA format
- Chicago style
- Bibliography formatting
- Academic writing
- Essay checker
- Citation guides
- Turabian
- Style guides
- Writing help
- Student tools
- Accidental plagiarism detection

- [Chicago / Turabian Citation Guide - BibMe Resources](https://www.bibme.org/citation-guide/chicago): Chicago/Turabian citation style guide and examples for research
